The Facemaker's Boutique is a Location within the Lower City in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.
“
You appear to be lost, dear. I specialise in fashion, not potato sacks.
„
— Figaro Pennygood, on the party's first visit

Overview

The Facemaker Boutique is a fashion house located in the Steeps district of Baldur's Gate, adjacent to The Glitter Gala. It stands close to the Upper City Gate Checkpoint and thus attracts clientele not only from the nearest quarters, but from the Upper City as well. The fashion house is a large two-storied building with a basement and the only entrance at X: -181 Y: -31.

The establishment is owned and run by  Figaro Pennygood, who inherited the business from his father Julio Facemaker. Figaro is the brother of  Carmen Pennygood, the owner of Carm's Garms in Wyrm's Crossing. The siblings are at odds with each other; both consider the other a diletante and lame in fashion matters.

As Figaro Pennygood has been marked as a quarry for a serial killer, the actual state of the building depends on the state and (if started) progress of the party's involvement in the ⁠Investigate the Murders and ⁠Impress the Murder Tribunal quests (see Involvement section below).

Building layout

Ground floor

The boutique's entrance is on the ground floor and leads to a large shopping room where  Bobula Hanvers and  Phlanders Hort are working as staff. Phlanders stands behind the counter and carries the  Facemaker Fashion Basement Key. On the bottom shelves of the counter is a  Gold Key which can be used to unlock a chest filled with dyes near the front window. The inlocked wicker chest behind the counter contains gold and alchemical ingredients.

On the surrounding shelves are multiple pieces of Camp Clothing from Rich to Aristocrat grades, as well as various headwear and shoes.

To the south of the front room is a smaller room with stairs leading to the first floor as well as a hatch to the basement.

To the sides of the counter are two double doors, both leading to the back area of the shop. Inside is a large salesroom, it contains more shelves with clothes, and a smaller dais with several barber's chairs and large mirrors for hairdressing services in its southern part. Multiple cabinets, bottle racks and bloodbanks here contain small amounts of gold and bottles with random dyes.

An opulent chest at X: -172 Y: -36 and a wicker chest at X: -169 Y: -46 both unlocked and red-outlined, contain gold and random arrows.

If Figaro survives throughout the ⁠Investigate the Murders quest, or it was never started, he acts as a trader, selling a vast assortment of Camp Clothing and dyes of various grades, including Very rare ones not to be found elsewhere in the game.

Obtaining a new piece of clothing from Figaro's stock awards one or more of the following inspirations:

  • ⁠Extravagance Required ( Guild Artisan background)
  • ⁠Threads of Fame ( Entertainer background)
  • ⁠Updating Your Wardrobe ( Noble background)

All these inspirations can be obtained only if the party member purchases a piece of clothing from Figaro himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro dies does not grant any of them.

Also, if Figaro is saved, his attitude towards the player character raises up to 100, which allows characters with the  Guild Artisan background earn the ⁠Valued Customer inspiration as well without any further efforts, if it was not obtained earlier.

First floor

Following the stairs up from the side room next to the entrance leads to a locked door, opened with a  DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check. Through the door are the living room and the bedroom. Both have several containers with mostly miscellaneous loot:

  • At X: -162 Y: -38 two Traveller's Chest with gold and random potions
  • At X: -168 Y: -39 wicker chest with random minor loot
  • At X: -178 Y: -40 opulent chest with gold and alchemical ingredients

In the bedroom is an empty strongbox in the wall which can be opened with  Figaro's Safe Key. On a desk in the bedroom is another of  Figaro's Chest Keys.[1] Next to these rooms, a large balcony can be reached from the hall.

Basement

The basement can be accessed through a locked, red-outlined hatch near the stairs to the first floor, opened by lockpicking (requires  DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check) or with the  Facemaker Fashion Basement Key, carried by Phlanders Hort.

The basement consists of several rooms connected together: a storehouse, a small lab where Figaro made experiments to invent a new type of dye, and a makeshift office.

In the office is a desk with the  The Last Will and Testament of Julio Facemaker and a  Forgery Kit on it. [2] On this same desk is small locked Gilded Chest which can be unlocked by using  Figaro's Chest Key, obtained from the Stack of Scrolls at X: -2343 Y: 1294.

Another large Opulent chest stands at X: -2342 Y: 1302. It is locked and trapped, requiring  DC 20 Perception Check to detect the trap,  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to disarm it, and  DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick. It can though be opened with  Figaro's Chest Key from the bedroom on the first floor. Inside, however, are only two random sets of Camp clothing of patriar grade.

Another wooden chest ( DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick) contains gold and random potions.

At X: -2334 Y: 1294 a  Sturdy destroyable wall can be spotted. Behind it is a Blast Mine and a locked Wooden Chest (requires  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick), containing some gold, ingots and alchemy ingredients.

Involvement

If the party started the ⁠Investigate the Murders and ⁠Impress the Murder Tribunal quests, and the serial killer  Dolor survives and escapes from the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home, he moves to the Facemaker's Boutique to the next victim in his list - Figaro.

In this case, neither of Figaro's employees are present inside. Instead, in the front room are two NPCs with signature "doppelganger" names (three more are in the backroom with Dolor). Upon opening any of the double doors the cutscene starts, where Dolor kills Figaro if the party do not interfere. If they do, a fight starts.  Devella Fountainhead is also there, already  paralysed by the murderers.[3]

Unlike the plot branch at the Highberry's Home, the encounter with Dolor at Figaro's waits to be triggered and resolved even after a long rest. When the dialogue triggers, the interacting character has an option to sneak back to the shadows, but this does not prevent the fight.[4]

After the encounter with the murder attempt is resolved, Figaro's employees appear in the building. If Figaro died, Phlanders Hort takes his place as a trader. Trading with him offers a smaller stock than Figaro's and does not bring the aforementioned inspirations.

If neither quest is active, Dolor is not present, and Figaro simply acts as a trader.

Outside the building

  • If the previous murder attempt by  Dolor was interrupted, and he managed to escape, there will be several clients of Figaro's,  Hannaah Befling,  Varce Humbletood, and  Kale Dorriacks waiting their turn outside the entrance, all of them disappointed with the time they have to wait.[5]
  • When exploring Szarr Palace, the party can find the  diary of  Leon Onufrio, one of the vampire spawn dwelling there, who wanted Figaro's services to ensure the safety of his little daughter  Victoria. Unfortunately, his plan never came to fruition.

  3. ↑ If the fight starts, Devella becomes the first target of the doppelgangers. If she survives, dialogue with her starts automatically, the layout of which depends on whether the party have already met her in the Elfsong Tavern. If they did not, all interactions and approval points are available here.
  4. ↑ If hiding succeeds, Dolor and his doppelganger assistants attack the rest of the party. If the interacting character is separated from the party and successfully hides from Dolor, the murderous squad remains in the building after killing Figaro and Devella and waits for the party to find them there.
  5. ↑ While the first two NPCs can be seen only in front of the doors, Kale Dorriacks – due to some glitches – may wander around the street and nearby locations, and can be seen, for example, on the first floor of the Lodge, in the Grey Harbour Docks, and even as far as the Water Queen's House. Nevertheless, her one-liner dialogue suggests that she is yet another tired-of-waiting client of Figaro's.
